awards.title: Global Champion and US Regional Winner, D3CODE 2025
awards.summary: UST's international student innovation challenge on AI, quantum computing and data ecosystems drew more than 25,000 students from Malaysia, India, Mexico, the United Kingdom and the United States. Team Neural Navigators (Nagur Shareef Shaik, Georgia State University; Vandna Rajpal, Stevens Institute of Technology) won the US regional round and then the global final with PRISM, an AI platform for no-code data analysis, ETL and predictive modeling, earning USD 15,000 in prizes (USD 5,000 for the US region and USD 10,000 as global winner) and an invitation to present at UST's D3 Conference in India.

awards.title: AxisSQL on the BIRD-SQL Text-to-SQL leaderboard
awards.summary: AxisSQL, submitted under UST, is listed on the official BIRD-SQL leaderboard (Aug 3, 2026) with 76.86% test execution accuracy and a 68.35 test R-VES efficiency score; the entry links to the public code. The work came from a research program with Professor Tatsunori Hashimoto's group at Stanford, and UST reports the result as 12th worldwide at submission.
